description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing improved performance, security patches, and access to modern language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 25. Update build configuration (Maven or Gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with Java 25. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or migrate javax.* to jakarta.* as part of this task.
tasks.taskSummary: Upgraded from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version and Dockerfile base images. Build passed and no test failures. No CVEs found in dependencies.
